blocks.text: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern the authorized use of LeadCRM, an internal Customer Relationship Management system developed by the LeadCRM Development Team, an external student capstone development team, for Camxian Technologies ("Company").
LeadCRM supports the Company's customer relationship management, sales operations, employee task coordination, business communications, workflow automation, and performance reporting.
The system is intended for authorized Company personnel and other expressly approved users.
By accessing LeadCRM, users agree to comply with applicable Company policies, these Terms, and relevant laws.
LeadCRM is a CRM application developed by the LeadCRM Development Team as a student capstone project for the Company's internal business operations.

Camxian Technologies operates LeadCRM for its authorized business activities, determines permitted business use, administers organizational accounts through designated personnel, establishes applicable organizational policies, and is responsible for its applicable legal and privacy obligations.

The LeadCRM Development Team consists of student capstone developers who are separate from Camxian Technologies' employees. The team developed LeadCRM for the organization and may provide maintenance or technical assistance where authorized. The team does not automatically own company records or act as Camxian Technologies' Data Protection Officer.
Ownership of software, source code, branding, and related intellectual property remains subject to applicable employment, development, licensing, and other agreements.
Only authorized users may access LeadCRM.
System accounts are created or managed by designated administrators.
Users must use their own approved credentials.
Account access is subject to assigned roles, permissions, account status, and other applicable security controls.
No user is automatically entitled to access all Company information.
All authorized users must:

items: Access information only for approved purposes.
Protect confidential customer and Company data.
Use LeadCRM only for legitimate business activities.
Comply with applicable Company policies and Philippine laws.

blocks.text: Account sharing is prohibited unless specifically authorized through an approved organizational procedure.

Use must remain related to legitimate Company operations.
Users must not:

items: Extract or disclose confidential records without permission.
Manipulate sales results or reporting data.
Delete information to conceal unauthorized activities.
Use Company information for personal gain without authorization.
Send unlawful or unauthorized marketing messages.
Attempt unauthorized access to another user's account.
Interfere with audit logs or security mechanisms.

blocks.text: Violations may result in access restrictions, disciplinary action where applicable, or other lawful measures.
LeadCRM uses role-based access control.
Administrators may assign users to available roles with defined permissions.
These permissions may determine whether a user can view, create, edit, archive, assign, or manage specific records and modules.
Users must not attempt to perform actions beyond their authorized permissions.
Camxian Technologies may modify user permissions based on legitimate operational and security requirements.
Customer records, sales activities, internal notes, and related information processed through LeadCRM must be used only for authorized Company business.
Users must maintain reasonable accuracy and confidentiality.
Business records and related access rights are governed by applicable Company policies, contractual arrangements, intellectual property rules, and applicable law.
The creation of a record does not grant a user personal ownership of that information.
Users authorized to send email or SMS campaigns must ensure that communications:

items: Are related to legitimate Company purposes.
Comply with applicable privacy and communications laws.
Do not contain deceptive or malicious content.
Do not improperly disclose confidential information.

blocks.text: Users must not use LeadCRM to send unauthorized mass communications.
Authorized users may configure or operate supported workflows within their assigned permissions.
Workflow configurations must serve legitimate business purposes.
Users must review relevant automation settings and avoid actions that would improperly modify records, send unwanted communications, or create misleading business information.
Significant unexpected workflow behavior should be reported through the Company's approved support procedures.
LeadCRM provides performance reporting for authorized organizational use.
Dashboard metrics, charts, and sales reports depend on the quality and completeness of the underlying records.
Users must not intentionally manipulate data to misrepresent Company performance.
Reports should be validated before making significant business or financial decisions.
LeadCRM reporting is not automatically a substitute for audited financial statements.
Camxian Technologies processes personal information in accordance with applicable laws and its approved Privacy Policy.
Users must comply with organizational confidentiality requirements.
Unauthorized copying, disclosure, or use of confidential information is prohibited.
